name: PalPanelServerMods
description: Server-only Community-Raid build with stable combat, static authoritative arena and Palworld-native visual spawn broadcast through APalNetworkTransmitter. arena-visual-006 uses SpawnNonReliableActorBroadcast with FNetworkActorSpawnParameters so visual markers are distributed through Palworld's own NetMulticast path. No client installation required.
